summary: Morning update: after communicating with St George Island State Park officials, beach flags may change from red to yellow this afternoon based on the latest conditions. Northeasterly winds will mostly be offshore which will keep surf heights low over the next several days. A moderate risk of rip currents is expected. The only exception is the Franklin County beaches, where the high risk looks to return on Wednesday and Thursday, due to an increasing component of Southeasterly swell.
